title: 第8章 因祸得福了
novel_title: 开局废灵根，成了宗门团宠小师叔
content_zh:
晨光从木窗的缝隙漏进来，正好落在顾念念的脸上。

    就不见光的双眸甫一睁开，又立刻闭上。

    好一会儿，才颤抖着睫毛缓缓睁开一条线。

    入目依旧是熟悉的木屋，就连窗台上放着的小花都是她亲手摘的。

    可她分明记得这些都毁了。

    她恍惚地看着，一切真实得像先前发生的一切都是一场梦。

    可，

    身体的疼痛还在继续。

    身上盖的被褥也不是原先的，多了一丝淡淡的草木香。

    她撑着胳膊想起来，指尖碰到了一抹冰凉。

    大脑还没做出反应，那冰凉像是活物一样自动蹭入她的手心。

    贴了一下后，又飞快地离开，眨眼间就悬在她的面前。

    顾念念看着悬在自己面前的桃夭，发白的嘴唇扯出一个微笑的弧度。

    “小剑剑，是你帮了我，对嘛？谢谢！”

    她记得发生的一切。

    甚至能感知到桃夭。

    洛靳有些意外。

    他记得师尊说过，极致混沌体的觉醒过程极为凶险，稍有不慎便会反噬宿主。

    现在顾念念醒了，比预期的还要早几天，说明混沌之力已经开始与她的身体真正融合。

    只是，混沌之力会潜移默化地影响心性。

    现在顾念念天真可爱，虽然也有市井磨练出来的圆滑和狡黠，还有些小聪明，也会使些小手段。

    但洛靳觉得这样的顾念念很好。

    可，如果她将来不是现在这个她，那他……

    洛靳如今已经正式晋升元婴初期，对自己的所修无情道也有了更深刻的认知。

    无情道修的是一种绝对的理性与清明。

    不是无情无义，而是感知和理解情感后，不会被情感裹挟而做出错误的判断。

    可抛开情感还有因果。

    修炼之人最忌因果牵绊，从他送出桃夭，再到得受顾念念无意点拨修为晋升，早就是因果牵绊。

    或许……

    青霜剑在他的识海里嗡嗡作响。

    似警告又似发怒。

    洛靳无奈地收回所有的思绪，对着青霜剑说了一句：知道了知道了，时机未到，我什么都不会做。

    说完，这才起身走到床前。

    “感觉怎么样？”

    顾念念看到洛靳，眼泪瞬间就下来了。

    “师兄，我好疼。”

    洛靳小心地将她扶坐了起来，靠在自己怀里，小心地抹去她脸上的泪珠。
content_en:
The morning light filtered in through the cracks in the wooden window and fell right on Gu Niannian's face.

    The blind eyes opened and closed immediately.

    After a while, her eyelashes slowly opened with trembling eyes.

    The familiar wooden house is still there, and even the flowers on the windowsill were picked by her herself.

    But she clearly remembered that these were ruined.

    She looked at it in a daze, as if everything that had happened before was a dream.

    Yes,

    The physical pain continued.

    The quilt covering him was not the original one, but had a faint scent of grass and woods.

    She stretched her arms and thought about it, and her fingertips touched a touch of coldness.

    Before her brain could react, the coldness automatically rubbed into her palm like a living thing.

    After sticking it for a while, he quickly left and was hanging in front of her in the blink of an eye.

    Gu Niannian looked at Taoyao hanging in front of her, her white lips forming a smile.

    "Xiao Jianjian, you helped me, right? Thank you!"

    She remembers everything that happened.

    He can even sense Tao Yao.

    Luo Jin was a little surprised.

    He remembered that his master said that the awakening process of the ultimate chaotic body is extremely dangerous, and it will backfire on the host if he is not careful.

    Now Gu Niannian woke up, a few days earlier than expected, which meant that the power of chaos had begun to truly integrate with her body.

    However, the power of chaos will subtly affect the mind.

    Now Gu Niannian is innocent and cute. Although she also has the tact and cunning tempered by the business world, she is also a little clever and can use some tricks.

    But Luo Jin thinks Gu Niannian is good like this.

    But, if she is not what she is now in the future, then he...

    Luo Jin has now officially been promoted to the early stage of Nascent Soul, and has a deeper understanding of the ruthless path he cultivates.

    The ruthless Taoism cultivates absolute rationality and clarity.

    It’s not that you are ruthless, but that after you perceive and understand emotions, you will not be coerced by emotions and make wrong judgments.

    But aside from emotions, there is also cause and effect.

    Cultivators are most afraid of being tied by cause and effect. From the time he sent Tao Yao to the time when Gu Niannian unintentionally prompted him to advance in cultivation, there has been a tie between cause and effect.

    Maybe...

    The Qingshuang Sword buzzed in his sea of consciousness.

    It sounds like a warning but also like anger.

    Luo Jin reluctantly took back all his thoughts and said to Qingshuang Sword: I know, I know, I won't do anything before the time comes.

    After saying that, he got up and walked to the bed.

    "How does it feel?"

    Gu Niannian burst into tears when she saw Luo Jin.

    "Brother, it hurts me so much."

    Luo Jin carefully helped her sit up, leaned into his arms, and carefully wiped away the tears on her face.
